mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, product_id, quantity, amount, status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, product_id, quantity, amount, status, create_time, pay_time, ship_time, close_time FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT id, order_no, product_id, quantity, amount, status, create_time, pay_time, ship_time, close_time FROM t_order ORDER BY id DESC
